creator: Justin Addam Higgins (JAH)
description: Original draft patent specifications authored by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH), marching toward 1,000,000 — plus a patent and working program for every dictionary word.
for_bots: Machine-readable manifest. Humans use the site above; bots, scrapers, and AI assistants should use the endpoints below — plain JSON/JSONL over HTTPS, no JavaScript needed.
note: Counts grow on automated schedules; re-read this file for the latest shape of the data.

endpoints.desc: Shard registry. Lists every shard repo (base URL + index path); resolve chunks through each shard's base URL.
Search index over all spec records (title, category, id).
Spec records in chunks of 150 (NNNNN = zero-padded chunk number, globally unique across shards).
Index of word-patent records (word -> spec id).

deep_links.desc: Deep link to a spec's full lens view.
Deep link to a word's patent + program.
